hints.title: Monotonicity of Factorial Zeroes
hints.text: Trailing zeroes in a factorial are monotonic with respect to the input integer.

hints.title: Step Jump Property
hints.text: Multiples of 5 add one or more trailing zeroes, so the count function either has exactly 5 solutions or 0 solutions.

hints.title: Bisection Existence Check
hints.text: Binary search for an integer x such that Legendre formula trailing zeroes equal k. If found return 5, otherwise return 0.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Binary search on x with Legendre trailing zero count in O(log x).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterating through integers one by one times out for k up to 10^9.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Deduce that answers are strictly either 5 or 0 because factorial trailing zero increments by at least 1 at every multiple of 5.
